headline: EPAM Systems (EPAM) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower After Cautious Analyst Target Cuts
summary: The latest analyst work on EPAM Systems reflects a reset in expectations, with price targets moving lower across both bullish and bearish research. Some analysts still point to a longer term growth story and keep Buy ratings, while others cite softer revenue guidance, weaker North American demand, and AI related pressure on traditional services as reasons for more cautious targets in the roughly US$85 to US$125 range. In the sections that follow, you will see how this evolving narrative may...
